# Support

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](SUPPORT.vi.md)

This is an open-source engineering/reproducibility project and does not provide a commercial support SLA.

## Where to ask

- Use the bug-report form for reproducible defects.
- Use the feature-request form for scoped improvements.
- Use the question form for setup/usage questions.
- Use the security process in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for vulnerabilities.

## What to include

For technical help, provide:

- repository commit SHA or release tag;
- Python/PyTorch versions when relevant;
- environment (Kaggle/local/other);
- accelerator topology;
- whether Internet was enabled;
- attached model path;
- first failed gate;
- a minimal log excerpt with secrets removed.

For GPU claims, state whether the session was actually Tesla T4 x2. CPU-only output cannot establish live dual-T4 routing behavior.
